newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Core blue chips seen highlighted on Seoul bourse.
newsitem.headline: Core blue chips seen highlighted on Seoul bourse.

text.p: Liquid institutional investors are expected to show selective buying interest in core blue chips on Friday, while the Seoul stock market would fluctuate on consolidation, brokers said.

They said Kia Group shares would continue to remain weak as many investors including foreigners still wanted to unload their holdings. A strong denial of finanical trouble rumours in the group failed to soothe investor concerns, brokers said.
"Primary blue chips and expensive info-tech companies will be in demand," said Jo Jae-hoon at Daewoo Securities.
The main index ended Thursday at 763.18, down 2.26 points.
Brokers said the market would fluctate on a technical rebound in some shares and consolidation.
Dong Ah Construction was seen escaping from Thursday's doldrums but would face selling pressure. The construction ministry on Thursday revoked its licence to build steel-framed bridges.
